title: Rubber Foot
author: Klave
description:
My very old function generator needed new feet, the original feet had cracked and fallen apart.

Using TPU I printed 4 of these and screwed them on with a 3x8mm plastic screw. The holes were drilled with a 2.4mm drill (3/32")

Print without support placing the wide side on the buildplate

rubber foot rubber spacer screw on foot spacer instrument repair

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
